description: Regression controlling for burial, concave vs convex conservation, spatial clustering permutation test, and insertion-groove contacts
code:
exec(open("work/lib.py").read())
import numpy as np, pandas as pd, json
from scipy import stats
import statsmodels.api as sm
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

T=pd.read_csv("work/per_residue.csv")
res,order=parse_pdb("work/AF-P38213.pdb")
coord={r[1]:res[r]['atoms'].get('CB',res[r]['atoms']['CA']) for r in order}

# ---- 1. regression: does concave-face membership add to burial in explaining conservation? ----
X=sm.add_constant(pd.DataFrame({'rsa':T.rsa,'concave_face':T.concave_face.astype(int)}))
m=sm.OLS(T.pct_id_all, X).fit()
print("OLS: %id(199 orthologs) ~ rSASA + concave_face")
print(m.summary2().tables[1].round(4).to_string())
print(f"R2={m.rsquared:.3f}, n={int(m.nobs)}\n")

# ---- 2. concave vs convex exposed face ----
cj=json.load(open("work/concave.json"))['DSF2 548-731']
inner=set(); 
for a,b in cj['inner_helices']: inner.update(range(a,b+1))
T['inner_helix']=T.resnum.isin(inner)
Te=T[T.rsa>=0.25]
a=Te[Te.concave_face].pct_id_all; b=Te[(~Te.concave_face)&(~Te.inner_helix)].pct_id_all
u,p=stats.mannwhitneyu(a,b,alternative='two-sided')
print(f"Exposed concave-face (n={len(a)}, med {np.median(a):.1f}) vs exposed convex/outer-helix residues "
      f"(n={len(b)}, med {np.median(b):.1f}): p={p:.3g}, AUC={u/(len(a)*len(b)):.2f}")

# ---- 3. are the most-conserved exposed residues spatially clustered? ----
rng=np.random.default_rng(0)
exp=T[T.rsa>=0.25].copy()
top=exp.nlargest(15,'pct_id_all')
def meanpd(nums):
    P=np.array([coord[n] for n in nums]); 
    d=np.linalg.norm(P[:,None,:]-P[None,:,:],axis=2)
    return d[np.triu_indices(len(P),1)].mean()
obs=meanpd(top.resnum.values)
null=np.array([meanpd(rng.choice(exp.resnum.values,15,replace=False)) for _ in range(5000)])
pz=(null<=obs).mean()
print(f"\nSpatial clustering of the 15 most-conserved exposed residues: mean pairwise CB distance "
      f"{obs:.1f} A vs random exposed null {null.mean():.1f} +/- {null.std():.1f} A, permutation p={pz:.4f}")
print("  top-15 conserved exposed residues:", " ".join(f"{r.aa}{r.resnum}({r.pct_id_all:.0f}%)" for r in top.itertuples()))
print("  of these, on the concave face:", int(top.concave_face.sum()), "/ 15")

# ---- 4. does the 620-642 insertion pack against the concave face? ----
ins=[n for n in range(618,645) if n in coord]
faceres=[x[0] for x in cj['face']]
allat={r[1]:np.array(list(res[r]['atoms'].values())) for r in order}
close=[]
for n in ins:
    for f in faceres:
        d=np.linalg.norm(allat[n][:,None,:]-allat[f][None,:,:],axis=2).min()
        if d<5.0: close.append((n,res[('A',n,' ')]['aa'],f,round(float(d),2)))
print(f"\nInsertion 618-644 heavy-atom contacts (<5 A) with concave-face residues: {len(close)}")
for c in sorted(close,key=lambda x:x[3])[:15]: print("   ", c)

# ---- figure ----
fig,ax=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(12,4.4))
a0=ax[0]
sc=a0.scatter(T.rsa,T.pct_id_all,s=20,c=T.concave_face.map({True:"#d62828",False:"#9aa0a6"}))
xs=np.linspace(0,1,50)
a0.plot(xs,m.params['const']+m.params['rsa']*xs,color="#9aa0a6",lw=2,label="fit, non-face")
a0.plot(xs,m.params['const']+m.params['concave_face']+m.params['rsa']*xs,color="#d62828",lw=2,label="fit, concave face")
a0.set_xlabel("relative solvent accessibility"); a0.set_ylabel("% identity, 199 fungal orthologs")
a0.set_title("Conservation is explained mainly by burial\n(concave-face term p=%.2f)"%m.pvalues['concave_face'])
a0.legend(fontsize=8); a0.grid(alpha=.3)
a1=ax[1]
a1.hist(null,bins=40,color="#9aa0a6"); a1.axvline(obs,color="#d62828",lw=2)
a1.set_xlabel("mean pairwise CB distance of 15 residues (A)"); a1.set_ylabel("permutations")
a1.set_title("Top-conserved exposed residues are not\nspatially clustered (p=%.2f)"%pz)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
T.to_csv("work/per_residue.csv",index=False)
